# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Confirmed that HEAD already kept alkalinity out of the mg-based N/C/O element ledger, then hardened that contract by making scalar budget metrics self-describing. This pass adds an explicit `BudgetMetricUnit` surface with legacy label-based unit inference on deserialize, wires the stage-trace budget emitters to tag alkalinity/nitrogen-cycle/substrate metrics with the correct meq/mg/g/cm units, documents that `budget_helpers::Element` and `SystemElementDelta` remain conserved mg-only helpers, and extends the alkalinity regression coverage so downstream consumers can rely on unit-tagged budget metrics instead of inferring everything from field names alone.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current budget and tracing paths, verified alkalinity was already recorded as a scalar `BudgetMetric` rather than an `ElementBudget`, and scoped the remediation to harden the public metric surface instead of widening the mg-based element API.
2. [Completed] Implemented `BudgetMetricUnit`, exported it through `types::mod`, added backward-compatible unit inference for legacy serialized metrics, and updated stage-trace metric emission to record explicit units for alkalinity, nitrogen-cycle, and substrate diagnostics.
3. [Completed] Clarified in-code docs that the `budget_helpers` element API is mg-only for conserved N/C/O, added regression coverage for metric-unit preservation and alkalinity meq tagging, and ran formatting plus targeted and broader `tank_core` validation.

## Validation Evidence

- cargo fmt --all
- cargo test -p tank_core --lib -- --nocapture
- cargo test -p tank_core --test nitrification_alkalinity -- --nocapture
- cargo test -p tank_core --test denitrification test_denitrification_reduces_nitrate_accumulation -- --nocapture (reproduces the unrelated failing denitrification fixture assertion)
- cargo test -p tank_core (fails only in `crates/tank_core/tests/denitrification.rs::test_denitrification_reduces_nitrate_accumulation`)

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_core` still fails in `crates/tank_core/tests/denitrification.rs::test_denitrification_reduces_nitrate_accumulation`; that test asserts its planted fixture starts with a suboxic zone and is outside the budget-metric/unit-tagging files changed in this pass.
